facts.statement: Apatosuchus was an extinct non-crocodylomorph loricatan pseudosuchian that lived in Germany during the Late Triassic.
facts.quote: Apatosuchus is an extinct genus of non-crocodylomorph loricatan pseudosuchian known from the Late Triassic of Germany.

facts.statement: The animal is known from a partial holotype skull found in the middle Stubensandstein of Baden-Württemberg, dating to the Norian stage.
facts.quote: It is known from a partial holotype skull from the middle Stubensandstein (a deposit that dates back to the Norian stage and is part of the Löwenstein Formation) in Baden-Württemberg.

facts.statement: The type species was first described by Friedrich von Huene in 1932, initially classified as a theropod dinosaur.
facts.quote: A. orbitoangulatus was first described by German paleontologist Friedrich von Huene in 1932, who considered it a species of the theropod dinosaur Halticosaurus.

facts.statement: Apatosuchus is considered a basal member of the clade Loricata.
facts.quote: Apatosuchus is now thought to be a basal member of the clade Loricata.

facts.statement: Apatosuchus was much smaller than other basal loricatans like Teratosaurus and Batrachotomus.
facts.quote: Apatosuchus is much smaller than other basal loricatans such as Teratosaurus and Batrachotomus.

facts.statement: Apatosuchus belongs to the unranked order Paracrocodylomorpha.
Apatosuchus belongs to the unranked family Loricata.
Apatosuchus lived between 215.38 and 211.18 million years ago during the Norian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Norian to Norian (215.38 to 211.18 million years ago)

facts.statement: A 2013 phylogenetic analysis identified Apatosuchus as the sister taxon to the clade containing Batrachotomus and more derived loricatans.
facts.quote: A phylogenetic analysis performed by Sues & Schoch (2013) found Apatosuchus to be the sister taxon of the clade formed by Batrachotomus and more derived loricatans.

rejected.statement: The genus name Apatosuchus, meaning 'deceptive crocodile', was established in 2013 by Sues and Schoch after the specimen was reclassified as a pseudosuchian archosaur.
rejected.quote: The name Apatosuchus, 'deceptive crocodile', was erected for H. orbitoangulatus by Hans-Dieter Sues and Rainer R. Schoch in 2013 when it was realized that the known material represented a pseudosuchian archosaur rather than a dinosaur.

rejected.quote: This position was supported by two unambiguous synapomorphies: the presence of a ridge on the dorsal surface of squamosal along the edge of supratemporal fossa, and concaved rear portion of the nasals at the midline.
